review_description: Very thorough and professional throughout the whole process.

As it was a small and relatively new company I was concerned until the system was installed. The installation was done by Eco Green but I was led to believe he had his own team that would do it. In the end the workmanship and great and it was done on the day promised.I am very happy with the result.
Great care to get the right system dos know what he is talking about
